name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause `Existence(switch_toggled)` hard is not stated in the task. The task only says that if the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been toggled before (a conditional rule). Therefore only a hard `Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)` is needed. The extra hard Existence forces the agent to toggle the switch even when it never reaches the exit, which adds an unintended requirement. Remove the `Existence(switch_toggled)` clause (and any reward for it).

texts: Reaching the exit cannot occur before the switch has been toggled.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
